statements.text: I started my security shift at 7:45 PM. At approximately 8:00 PM, I saw Maya near the exhibition room. At 8:15 PM, I saw Daniel leaving the museum. I did not see Ryan that evening.
I entered the exhibition room at 7:55 PM and confirmed that the diamond was present. I left at 8:10 PM. I saw Ryan near the storage room at approximately 8:20 PM.
I entered the museum at 8:05 PM. I was looking at the exhibits until approximately 8:25 PM, when I left the building. I did not speak to Alex.
I was repairing a light in the exhibition room from 8:00 PM until 8:30 PM. I saw Maya leave at 8:10 PM. I did not see Daniel inside the exhibition room.
